symptom: create or modify odata service over a Studio Pro service: EntitySet PageSize 10000 -> 0, entity sets reordered, member CanBeEmpty recomputed, ExportLevel deleted, AuthenticationTypes marker 1 -> 3
cause: The modify path rebuilt entity types/sets from the publish block (no spelling for PageSize without paging, set order, CanBeEmpty); the model had no ExportLevel; the writer used a marker-3 list copied from the legacy writer, not Studio Pro
insight: Parity with the legacy writer is not evidence of what Studio Pro writes; measure markers on a Studio Pro fixture. A probe that runs describe output with the verb rewritten to create or modify (mdl/roundtrip TestTestAppCreateOrModifyProbe) shows what a verb switch would lose before switching it
